[[File:CutLawquaneStaff-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]] holding a farming staff]]

A '''staff''' was a long melee weapon. It could also be a simple tool used by farmers to herd animals or perform general farming tasks.

==History==
Staffs were an early form of weapon, generally made out of wood, but sometimes made out of metal. They could also be used for ceremonial purposes. There were several variations of the weapon, some advanced, others not as advanced. Wood staffs were used by the [[Janta]], a [[Dantari]] tribe native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Baran Do]] Sages from [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] also used wooden staffs, which they used during training.

*[[Zhaboka/Legends|Zhaboka]], or Zabrak [[Quarterstaff/Legends|quarterstaff]]
*[[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Double-bladed lightsabers]] were often known as saberstaffs
*[[San-Ni staff]], a sort of tri-sectioned staff
*[[Speaker's staff/Legends|Speaker's staff]], a sort of ceremonial staff

==Known Users==
This is a list of all known users of any variation of staff.
*[[Siolo Ur Manka]] (wooden staff)
*[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] (saberstaff)
*[[Tsyr]] ([[Cortosis staff/Legends|cortosis staff]])
*[[Jastus Farr]] (saberstaff)
*[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] ([[Speaker's staff/Legends|Speaker's staff]])
There were many other wielders of the various forms of staff.
